items.html:
Implemented ordinary sw, cw, and pw dispatch through existing Rust derivative records, including broadcast inputs and periodic geometry. Shared logic lives in _wave_functions.py; NumPy behavior and ufunc attributes remain available.

Verified:

  • 51 new tests passed across Advect, JAX JIT, PyTorch, and Autograd.
  • 981 existing wave/ufunc tests passed; 22 expected skips.
  • Ruff and Pyrefly passed.

Documented the fixed axial-label matching convention. Explicit remaining limitations: independent wavevector derivatives in sw/cw.periodic_to_pw, and axial-label derivatives in cw.to_sw.

No commits, builds, dependency installation, or release coordination performed.
